comment: Role of Science &Technology in Shaping the Modern Era Dr. Maurakis was awesome! His class can be challenging but he makes up for it with enthusiasm. Must take good notes to pass. His test will make you think. They are not the typical yes/no. He wants you to know & understand the material not just for a test. Field trip to Science Museum was a plus!

Class is very interesting & enjoyable. It requires a bit of reading, research, writing, & presenting but is worth the effort. Professor is traditional in the sense that you have to write out your notes while he lectures & exams are written (no mult choice or T/F) but if you do the reading & pay attention, you will do very well. His grading is fair.
